text: Average unconstrained mutual fund performance over the three years preceding the study was lower than the return on the ten-year Treasury, and poor performance was often accompanied by high fees and increased credit risk.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: On average, UMF performance has disappointed over the last three years, with returns lower than the return on the ten-year Treasury.43 Often, poor UMF performance has been accompanied by high fees and increased credit risk.
